title: The wharves after dark
summary: Downtime on the river stairs at night, between the Drowned Rat and the Heron.
assumes: The player hasn't yet gone into the Heron warehouse or dealt with what happens there tonight (the loading, the true book, the Master's visit).

routes.when: The player sets off for the Heron warehouse (or says they're going there now), following the lead.

lead.what: The Heron warehouse, at the downriver end of the wharves, is loading a barge tonight that sails on the ebb at the second bell after midnight; if Hobb talked, the gentleman comes at midnight to see it off.
placedWith: Sergeant Kell's own errand (she's going there)
